title: processkit principal
description: The principal of a request (access-control@v1 PK-ACC-017, PK-ACC-037, PK-ACC-048). It is the data of processkit auth whoami and the principal member of access log records. It never contains credential material.

user.description: User identifier as the authenticator asserts it; system:anonymous for the anonymous principal.

groups.description: Group names as the authenticator asserts them, without duplicates, sorted by Unicode code point; exactly ["system:unauthenticated"] for the anonymous principal.
